normalisation: as src/forest.js: Box3.setFromObject(source), base centre to the origin, scaled to unit height
layout: hemi-octahedral, frames on grid vertices: frame (i, j) is captured from impFrameDir(i, j, grid) and fills atlas texels x in [i, i+1) * frameSize, y in [j, j+1) * frameSize, y up (GL texture space)

albedo.encoding: RGB: unlit base colour, sRGB-encoded (load as SRGBColorSpace, shader reads linear). A: true coverage (fraction of 16 supersamples hit; mips box-filtered, so coverage is preserved). Colours dilated into transparent texels.

normal.encoding: RGB: mean of the covered supersamples' tree-space unit normals * 0.5 + 0.5 (NoColorSpace), not renormalised: its length is the normals' coherence (1 = flat surface). Dilated.

bakedWith: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M4, Unspecified Version)
